name: Senior SAP consultant moving toward manufacturing in-house

constraints: Little travel rather than weekly client visits
context.company_awareness: Knows manufacturing employers; module expertise unspecified

trigger: Another client rollout requires extended weekly travel; the consultant starts monitoring internal SAP teams at manufacturers.

searches_run.query: SAP Inhouse Consultant Deutschland Hersteller Stellenangebote
searches_run.observation: Results included StepStone, manufacturer ATS pages and module-specific roles. The directly inspected PERI role clearly described internal manufacturing work and three office days, with travel quantity unstated.

searches_run.query: Senior SAP inhouse consultant geringe Reisebereitschaft Hersteller Germany
searches_run.observation: Recruiter-distributed listings explicitly advertised very low travel or periodic attendance, but location labels and wording varied. In-house and hybrid are not evidence of a precise travel ceiling.

sources.title: SAP S/4HANA Inhouse Consultant (PP) — PERI
sources.supports: Direct manufacturer posting describes SAP PP manufacturing duties, German/English and a three-office/two-home-day arrangement. No quantified business-travel requirement was visible.

sources.title: SAP Inhouse Consultant jobs — StepStone
sources.supports: Retrieved page includes named manufacturers and module-specific vacancies. Counts and salary summaries are not adopted.

sources.title: SAP SD/MM Inhouse Senior Consultant — KA Resources
sources.supports: Retrieved recruiter listing uses very-low-travel wording and hybrid details. It does not establish exact travel frequency or a verified current employer match.

best_entry_page.primary_query: SAP Inhouse Stellen bei bestimmten Unternehmen beobachten
best_entry_page.promise: Follow SAP openings at selected employers and compare module, work arrangement and published travel requirements.
best_entry_page.cta: Select your manufacturing employers and save module-specific SAP alerts.
proof_needed: Verify coverage for the actual shortlist.
Show that SAP modules are represented accurately; module examples are not this persona's asserted skills.
Keep office attendance separate from customer or plant travel.
Pro checks should identify explicit travel wording and unknowns.
Demonstrate recurring alerts beyond employers' own alert forms.
Create a new indexable landing; current company/search pages are noindex.

conversion_objections: Will consulting-service roles slip into an in-house search?
Does the title conceal international plant rollouts?
Can I follow only my module at selected manufacturers?
How often is office attendance required?
Can I see missing travel details rather than a false no-travel match?

avoid_targeting.reason: In-house work does not guarantee zero travel.
Training intent is outside job discovery.
Freelance-market intent conflicts with the chosen employed in-house move.

message_to_founder: Simulation: Ich will meine SAP-Erfahrung behalten, aber nicht jede Woche beim nächsten Kunden sein. Wenn ihr meine Zielunternehmen und Module zuverlässig abdeckt und Dienstreisen von Bürotagen trennt, sind gezielte Alarme interessant.
confidence_and_limits: Synthetic bilingual specialist. Two searches and one direct employer inspection; no claim about total SAP demand or typical travel. Exact module, home location and acceptable travel frequency are unknown.
